dimensional_specification: Modern slim-shank Pozidriv chipboard/plywood screw visualization proxy

material.name: Bright zinc plated steel
material.note: Bright zinc finish with neutral cool highlights; passivation colour is unspecified.

modelling_choices.catalogue_length: Conservative extension label for every length; comparable dimension tables do not establish Screw-Tite stock availability.
modelling_choices.certification: Similar-product visualization only; does not identify the stocked product or certify DIN conformity.
modelling_choices.display: Smooth pointed thread envelope tapering into the slender plain shank; same recessed head.
modelling_choices.head: HSB nominal/midpoint head diameter and published head/neck clearance. Selected 90 degree cone, 0.10d rim, small fillet and a slender cylindrical neck; head-to-thread clearance is shortened only on tiny catalogue extensions.
modelling_choices.identity: Modern chipboard/plywood screw proxy requested by user; slim shank with 40 degree wood threads. Screw-Tite remains the preferred comparison; its exact Tri-Lock, ribs and twin-start transition are not reproduced.
modelling_choices.markings: Unidentified manufacturer and property-class stamps omitted.
modelling_choices.recess: Motu modern chipboard table supplies Pozidriv mouth and midpoint penetration at 2.5-6 mm; 2 mm retains the similar-head DIN 965 Z1 mouth/depth proxy. ISO 4757 wing/taper visual cavity, not a gauge model.
modelling_choices.runout: Selected one-pitch fade into a smooth shank; limited to one third of the threaded envelope on very short entries.
modelling_choices.small_sizes: 2.5 mm head/core/shank/pitch use Motu dimensions (shank uses wire diameter). 2 mm head/core/shank are scaled from 2.5 mm, with separately published 0.9 mm small wood-thread pitch and DIN 965 Z1 recess. Only the 2 mm profile is a scaled dimensional extension.
modelling_choices.thread: HSB modern chipboard core midpoints and nominal pitch, 40 degree flanks, selected 0.02P crest land. Plain shank uses published minimum diameter, independently of the thread crest.
modelling_choices.thread_coverage: User requests a bare section below every head. Target b=0.6L, capped at 72 mm, plus a one-pitch runout. Reserve a plain shank of at least min(0.5d, 25% of available shaft), shortening the thread on tiny catalogue lengths. Coverage is an explicit visualization choice; actual Screw-Tite products vary.
modelling_choices.tip: Selected point length 1.25 diameters, shortened to 60% of the threaded envelope on short extensions. This approximates a plain sharp chipboard point; cutting flutes and serrations omitted.

note: Similar-product modern chipboard/plywood screw visualization; not an exact Screw-Tite model or certified DIN part.

candidate_standards: Tite-Fix Screw-Tite / Screw-Tite 2 proprietary supplier drawing
implementation_requirements: Dedicated triangular-core, variable-start wood-thread and double-countersunk-head geometry; the metric machine-thread generator is not compatible.

known_specification.thread_profile: Tri-Lock triangular core, single and twin thread zones
